The main takeaway from our work is that
the cellular basis for the genesis of the J wave, T wave, and TDR in the ECG is the same as the cellular basis for cardiac arrhythmogenesis.

the cellular basis for the Brugada ECG pattern is a preferential abbreviation in repolarization of the right ventricle epicardium, and that the cellular basis of the long‐QT‐syndrome‐associated T‐wave alternans is a transmural dispersion in action potential durations.
